question: Which sport is played by the Indian sportsperson Shafali Verma?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shafali Verma** is an Indian cricketer who plays for the national women's cricket team.
 
• She made her debut for the Indian women's cricket team at the age of 15.
 
• Shafali is known for her aggressive batting style and has been a key player in various international matches.
 
• She has set numerous records, including being the youngest Indian to score a half-century in international cricket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shafali Verma** was born on January 28, 2004, in Rohtak, Haryana, India.
 
• She was inspired by Sachin Tendulkar and started playing cricket at a very young age.
 
• Shafali has also played in the Women's T20 Challenge and other domestic cricket leagues.
 
• She continues to be a promising talent for Indian women's cricket and has a bright future ahead.
